written.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to join video calls and take notes
written.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Meetings, a beta feature that allows Claude to join video calls as a visible participant, take notes, answer questions, and draft documents in real time. The tool is launching on Claude Team and Enterprise plans, initially supporting Google Meet with Microsoft Teams support also announced.

written.headline: Jensen Huang struggled to access Beijing chip policymakers
written.summary: Sources report that despite over 20 years of business in China, former Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang struggled to gain access to policymakers driving Beijing's chip self-sufficiency campaign.

written.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid scandals, ending an era for Big Tech
written.summary: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned following admissions of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, and chip smuggling scandals. Around 60 employees reported directly to Huang, who had no designated successor.

written.headline: Nvidia faces leadership transition and market shifts after Jensen Huang's exit
written.summary: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO following revelations about personal relationships, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO. Nvidia shares fell 4.34% to $166.19 following the resignation, while competitor AMD shares rose 5.86%.
